symptom: describe page -> exec reported 'Replaced page' for unchanged Marketplace pages (AgentCommons 4.4.0 AgentImport_SelectVersionAndModel, MCPView_New, MCPView_New_EditDisplayNames; MxGenAIConnector 7.4.0 ConfigurationStringImport_NewEdit) on Mendix 11.16.1; a second exec was Unchanged. ako/mxcli#2106 listed the same pages from FactoryManagement.
cause: Two values MDL does not state: a widget's TabIndex (Studio Pro stores 1 on a footer button and -1 on a combo box, as int64; the writer writes int32 0), and the parameters of an input widget's LabelTemplate (describe prints a check box label '{1}' as text only, so the rebuild wrote no parameter and the label would read '{1}').
fix: CarryUnexpressed keeps a stored non-zero TabIndex over a written 0, and a stored LabelTemplate's Parameters when the written template has the same text and none.
insight: FactoryManagement itself is not reachable from a cloud session, but most of #2106's pages are Marketplace modules: `mxcli marketplace install` of AgentCommons, ConversationalUI, MxGenAIConnector, GenAICommons and MCPClient into a TestApp copy (plus the Markdown viewer widget their pages use) reproduced 4 rewrites in one describe->exec sweep. The first carry did nothing live although its unit test passed: Studio Pro stores TabIndex as int64 and the fixture used int32 — a value's BSON width is part of what a carry has to match.
test: modelsdk/canon/unexpressed_tabindex_labelparams_test.go (TabIndex int32 and int64, label parameters, and a control that changed text or parameters still land); live: 47 Marketplace pages, 77 TestApp, 16 PedApp all 'in sync' after one exec
